ucs.title: [LLM] Kimsuky (APT43 / Emerald Sleet) LNK-to-LOLBin cloud-staging chain
ucs.description: Detects Kimsuky's signature spearphishing chain: an archive/email/explorer-launched LNK or HWP/PDF double-extension lure spawns powershell/mshta/cmd/regsvr32 that either pulls AppleSeed/BabyShark/ReconShark second-stage payloads from legitimate cloud storage (Dropbox, Google Drive, OneDrive, Yandex, Mega, Blogspot) or runs encoded PowerShell with DownloadString/IEX. This combination — archive-parent + script-interpreter child + cloud-staging or hidden-encoded fetch — is the dominant Kimsuky initial-access pattern reported by KISA, Mandiant, Microsoft (Emerald Sleet) and CrowdStrike (Velvet Cho
ucs.splunk: | tstats summariesonly=t count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime values(Processes.process) as cmdline values(Processes.process_hash) as sha256 from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes where Processes.process_name IN ("powershell.exe","pwsh.exe","mshta.exe","wscript.exe","cscript.exe","regsvr32.exe","cmd.exe","curl.exe","certutil.exe") Processes.parent_process_name IN ("explorer.exe","winrar.exe","7zg.exe","7zfm.exe","outlook.exe","bandizip.exe") Processes.user!="*$" by host Processes.user Processes.process_name Processes.process Processes.parent_process_name | `drop_dm_object_name(Processes)` | eval cmd_lc=lower(process) | where match(cmd_lc, "(dropbox|dl\.dropboxusercontent|docs\.google\.com|drive\.google\.com|onedrive\.live\.com|1drv\.ms|mediafire|pcloud|yandex|mega\.nz|blogspot)") OR (match(cmd_lc, "(-enc|encodedcommand|frombase64string|-w hidden|-windowstyle hidden)") AND match(cmd_lc, "(downloadstring|downloadfile|invoke-webrequest|start-bitstransfer|iex|invoke-expression|net\.webclient)")) OR (process_name="mshta.exe" AND match(cmd_lc, "https?://")) OR (process_name="regsvr32.exe" AND match(cmd_lc, "/i:.*http")) OR (process_name="certutil.exe" AND match(cmd_lc, "(-urlcache|-decode)")) | convert ctime(firstTime) ctime(lastTime)
ucs.kql:
let _suspect_clouds = dynamic(["dropbox","dl.dropboxusercontent","docs.google.com","drive.google.com","onedrive.live.com","1drv.ms","mediafire.com","pcloud.com","yandex","mega.nz","blogspot"]);
DeviceProcessEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(7d)
| where AccountName !endswith "$"
| where InitiatingProcessFileName in~ ("explorer.exe","winrar.exe","7zg.exe","7zfm.exe","outlook.exe","bandizip.exe")
| where FileName in~ ("powershell.exe","pwsh.exe","mshta.exe","wscript.exe","cscript.exe","regsvr32.exe","cmd.exe","curl.exe","certutil.exe")
| extend cmd_lc = tolower(ProcessCommandLine)
| where
    cmd_lc has_any (_suspect_clouds)
    or (cmd_lc has_any ("-enc","encodedcommand","frombase64string","-w hidden","-windowstyle hidden")
        and cmd_lc has_any ("downloadstring","downloadfile","invoke-webrequest","start-bitstransfer","iex","invoke-expression","net.webclient"))
    or (FileName =~ "mshta.exe" and cmd_lc matches regex @"https?://")
    or (FileName =~ "regsvr32.exe" and cmd_lc has "/i:" and cmd_lc has "http")
    or (FileName =~ "certutil.exe" and cmd_lc has_any ("-urlcache","-decode"))
    or InitiatingProcessCommandLine matches regex @"(?i)\.(lnk|pdf|hwp|docx?|xlsx?|pptx?)\s*\.(exe|lnk|js|vbs|hta|cmd|bat)"
| project Timestamp, DeviceName, AccountName,
          Parent=InitiatingProcessFileName,
          ParentCmd=InitiatingProcessCommandLine,
          Child=FileName, ChildCmd=ProcessCommandLine, SHA256
| order by Timestamp desc
ucs.sentinel_kql:
let _suspect_clouds = dynamic(["dropbox","dl.dropboxusercontent","docs.google.com","drive.google.com","onedrive.live.com","1drv.ms","mediafire.com","pcloud.com","yandex","mega.nz","blogspot"]);
SecurityEvent
| where TimeGenerated > ago(7d)
| where EventID == 4688
| where AccountType == "User"
| where Account !endswith "$"
| where ParentProcessName has_any (@"\explorer.exe", @"\winrar.exe", @"\7zg.exe", @"\7zfm.exe", @"\outlook.exe", @"\bandizip.exe")
| where NewProcessName has_any (@"\powershell.exe", @"\pwsh.exe", @"\mshta.exe", @"\wscript.exe", @"\cscript.exe", @"\regsvr32.exe", @"\cmd.exe", @"\curl.exe", @"\certutil.exe")
| extend cmd_lc = tolower(CommandLine)
| where
    cmd_lc has_any (_suspect_clouds)
    or (cmd_lc has_any ("-enc","encodedcommand","frombase64string","-w hidden","-windowstyle hidden")
        and cmd_lc has_any ("downloadstring","downloadfile","invoke-webrequest","start-bitstransfer","iex","invoke-expression","net.webclient"))
    or (NewProcessName endswith @"\mshta.exe" and cmd_lc matches regex @"https?://")
    or (NewProcessName endswith @"\regsvr32.exe" and cmd_lc has "/i:" and cmd_lc has "http")
    or (NewProcessName endswith @"\certutil.exe" and cmd_lc has_any ("-urlcache","-decode"))
| project TimeGenerated, Computer, Account, NewProcessName, CommandLine, ParentProcessName
| order by TimeGenerated desc
ucs.sigma_yaml:
title: Kimsuky LNK to LOLBin Cloud-Staging Chain
id: 8d2c1f3a-9b7e-4e1c-8a02-7c9c2e9b1f44
status: experimental
description: Detects Kimsuky/APT43/Emerald Sleet spearphishing chain — archive/email/explorer parent spawning a script-interpreter or LOLBin that fetches second-stage payload from legitimate cloud storage or runs encoded PowerShell with download cradles.
references:
  - https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0094/
author: SOC Detection Eng
date: 2026/05/18
logsource:
  product: windows
  category: process_creation
detection:
  parent:
    ParentImage|endswith:
      - '\explorer.exe'
      - '\winrar.exe'
      - '\7zg.exe'
      - '\7zfm.exe'
      - '\outlook.exe'
      - '\bandizip.exe'
  child:
    Image|endswith:
      - '\powershell.exe'
      - '\pwsh.exe'
      - '\mshta.exe'
      - '\wscript.exe'
      - '\cscript.exe'
      - '\regsvr32.exe'
      - '\cmd.exe'
      - '\curl.exe'
      - '\certutil.exe'
  cloud:
    CommandLine|contains:
      - 'dropbox'
      - 'dl.dropboxusercontent'
      - 'docs.google.com'
      - 'drive.google.com'
      - 'onedrive.live.com'
      - '1drv.ms'
      - 'mediafire'
      - 'pcloud'
      - 'yandex'
      - 'mega.nz'
      - 'blogspot'
  enc:
    CommandLine|contains:
      - '-enc'
      - 'EncodedCommand'
      - 'FromBase64String'
      - '-w hidden'
      - '-WindowStyle Hidden'
  net:
    CommandLine|contains:
      - 'DownloadString'
      - 'DownloadFile'
      - 'Invoke-WebRequest'
      - 'Start-BitsTransfer'
      - 'Net.WebClient'
      - 'IEX'
      - 'Invoke-Expression'
  condition: parent and child and (cloud or (enc and net))
falsepositives:
  - Admin one-liners launched from Explorer that legitimately fetch from cloud storage
level: high
tags:
  - attack.initial_access
  - attack.execution
  - attack.t1204.002
  - attack.t1059.001
  - attack.t1218.005
  - attack.t1027.013
  - attack.t1102.002
  - attack.g0094

ucs.title: [LLM] Kimsuky (APT43 / TA427) mailbox forwarding rule to Korean free-mail or anonymous webmail
ucs.description: Detects Kimsuky's post-compromise email-collection signature — they routinely plant Outlook/OWA inbox forwarding (or Set-Mailbox ForwardingSMTPAddress) on victim accounts of NK-focused journalists, defectors, academics and policy analysts, sending copies to throwaway addresses on naver/daum/hanmail/nate/kakao or to anonymous webmail (ProtonMail, Tutanota, Yandex, Mail.ru, 163, QQ). Reported by Mandiant (APT43), Microsoft (TA427/Emerald Sleet) and Proofpoint as a recurring TTP — distinct from typical BEC because the forwarding targets are non-English ROK/RU/CN providers rather than gmail/outloo
ucs.splunk: | tstats summariesonly=t count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime values(All_Changes.command) as command values(All_Changes.object_attrs) as attrs values(All_Changes.src) as src from datamodel=Change where All_Changes.command IN ("New-InboxRule","Set-InboxRule","UpdateInboxRules","Set-Mailbox") All_Changes.status=success by All_Changes.user All_Changes.command | `drop_dm_object_name(All_Changes)` | eval attrs_lc=lower(attrs) | where match(attrs_lc, "(forwardto|redirectto|forwardasattachmentto|deliverto|forwardingsmtpaddress)") AND match(attrs_lc, "(@naver\.com|@daum\.net|@hanmail\.net|@kakao\.com|@nate\.com|@protonmail\.com|@protonmail\.ch|@tutanota\.com|@yandex\.com|@yandex\.ru|@mail\.ru|@163\.com|@qq\.com)") | convert ctime(firstTime) ctime(lastTime)
ucs.kql:
let _suspect_external = dynamic(["@naver.com","@daum.net","@hanmail.net","@kakao.com","@nate.com","@protonmail.com","@protonmail.ch","@tutanota.com","@yandex.com","@yandex.ru","@mail.ru","@163.com","@qq.com","@yopmail.com"]);
CloudAppEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(7d)
| where Application in~ ("Microsoft Exchange Online","Office 365")
| where ActionType in~ ("New-InboxRule","Set-InboxRule","UpdateInboxRules","Set-Mailbox","Set-TransportRule")
| extend Raw = tostring(RawEventData)
| extend Raw_lc = tolower(Raw)
| where Raw_lc has_any ("forwardto","redirectto","forwardasattachmentto","deliverto","forwardingsmtpaddress")
| where Raw_lc has_any (_suspect_external)
| project Timestamp, AccountDisplayName, AccountObjectId, IPAddress, CountryCode, ISP, UserAgent, ActionType, ObjectName, RawEventData
| order by Timestamp desc
ucs.sentinel_kql:
let _suspect_external = dynamic(["naver.com","daum.net","hanmail.net","kakao.com","nate.com","protonmail.com","protonmail.ch","tutanota.com","yandex.com","yandex.ru","mail.ru","163.com","qq.com","yopmail.com"]);
OfficeActivity
| where TimeGenerated > ago(7d)
| where OfficeWorkload =~ "Exchange"
| where Operation in~ ("New-InboxRule","Set-InboxRule","UpdateInboxRules","Set-Mailbox","Set-TransportRule")
| where ResultStatus =~ "Succeeded"
| extend Params = tostring(Parameters)
| extend Params_lc = tolower(Params)
| where Params_lc has_any ("forwardto","redirectto","forwardasattachmentto","deliverto","forwardingsmtpaddress")
| where Params_lc has_any (_suspect_external)
| project TimeGenerated, UserId, ClientIP, UserAgent, Operation, Parameters, MailboxOwnerUPN
| order by TimeGenerated desc
ucs.sigma_yaml:
title: Kimsuky Email Forwarding Rule to Korean Free-Mail or Anonymous Webmail
id: 6f3e0a52-2c6c-4b81-9a4d-bb6e91a5b1c2
status: experimental
description: New or modified Exchange Online inbox-forwarding rule (or mailbox forwarding SMTP address) pointing at free-mail providers commonly abused by Kimsuky (APT43 / Emerald Sleet / TA427) for remote mailbox collection from NK-focused victims.
references:
  - https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0094/
  - https://attack.mitre.org/techniques/T1114/003/
author: SOC Detection Eng
date: 2026/05/18
logsource:
  product: m365
  service: exchange
detection:
  selection_op:
    Operation:
      - 'New-InboxRule'
      - 'Set-InboxRule'
      - 'UpdateInboxRules'
      - 'Set-Mailbox'
    ResultStatus: 'Succeeded'
  selection_fwd:
    Parameters|contains:
      - 'ForwardTo'
      - 'RedirectTo'
      - 'ForwardAsAttachmentTo'
      - 'DeliverTo'
      - 'ForwardingSmtpAddress'
  selection_dst:
    Parameters|contains:
      - '@naver.com'
      - '@daum.net'
      - '@hanmail.net'
      - '@kakao.com'
      - '@nate.com'
      - '@protonmail.com'
      - '@protonmail.ch'
      - '@tutanota.com'
      - '@yandex.com'
      - '@yandex.ru'
      - '@mail.ru'
      - '@163.com'
      - '@qq.com'
  condition: all of selection_*
falsepositives:
  - Genuine user-initiated personal forwarding to a Korean free-mail account (verify with the user)
level: high
tags:
  - attack.collection
  - attack.t1114.003
  - attack.t1114.002
  - attack.g0094
ucs.datadog_query: source:office365 @Operation:(New-InboxRule OR Set-InboxRule OR UpdateInboxRules OR Set-Mailbox OR Set-TransportRule) @ResultStatus:Succeeded (@Parameters:*ForwardTo* OR @Parameters:*RedirectTo* OR @Parameters:*ForwardAsAttachmentTo* OR @Parameters:*DeliverTo* OR @Parameters:*ForwardingSmtpAddress*) (@Parameters:*@naver.com* OR @Parameters:*@daum.net* OR @Parameters:*@hanmail.net* OR @Parameters:*@kakao.com* OR @Parameters:*@nate.com* OR @Parameters:*@protonmail.com* OR @Parameters:*@protonmail.ch* OR @Parameters:*@tutanota.com* OR @Parameters:*@yandex.com* OR @Parameters:*@yandex.ru* OR @Parameters:*@mail.ru* OR @Parameters:*@163.com* OR @Parameters:*@qq.com*)
ucs.rationale: Generic auto-forward rules fire all the time (BEC tooling, consultants forwarding to gmail). What pins this on Kimsuky/APT43/TA427 is the destination set: Korean domestic free-mail (naver, daum, hanmail, kakao, nate) and the anonymous webmail providers (ProtonMail, Tutanota, Yandex, Mail.ru, 163, QQ) repeatedly observed in Mandiant's APT43 report (March 2023), Microsoft's TA427/Emerald Sleet bulle
